## AGENT 7: WEEKLY REPORTING

**Two entry points:**
1. Schedule Trigger — Monday 9 AM IST (3:30 UTC)
2. Webhook POST /generate-report — on-demand

**Flow:**
1. Fetch active brands from Airtable
2. Sequentially fetch Projects, Scripts, Invoices
3. Aggregate per-brand metrics in Code node
4. Gemini generates a no-fluff weekly report
5. Post to Slack #ugc-agent-notifications
6. Respond to webhook (on-demand path only)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', report_length: $('Parse Report Text').first().json.report_text.length, brand_count: ($('Parse Report Text').first().json.report_data || {}).brand_count || 0, report: $('Parse Report Text').first().json.report_text }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// Weekly path — no webhook to respond to, just log
return [{ json: { done: true, message: 'Weekly report posted to Slack' } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: "reporting", event_type: "report_generated", brand_name: "", client_code: "", severity: "info", message: "Weekly report generated", payload: JSON.stringify({ mode: $json.mode, brand_count: $json.report_data?.brand_count || 0, period: $json.report_data?.period_label || "weekly" }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}
